display_long_description:
Apocalypse Zombie: Last Stand

The world has fallen. Civilization is gone.
All that remains is one last fortress… and you.

Apocalypse Zombie: Last Stand is a high-intensity VR zombie shooter set in a brutal post-apocalyptic world where survival means holding the line against endless hordes of the undead.

You stand at the final defensive position. Zombies come from all directions. There is no escape — only the last stand.

🧟‍♂️ SURVIVE THE APOCALYPSE

Waves of zombies will relentlessly attack your fortress. Each wave grows stronger, faster, and more aggressive. Your goal is simple but unforgiving: survive as long as possible.

Every second matters. Every shot counts.

🔫 TRUE VR SHOOTER COMBAT

Physically aim, reload, and fire using full VR controls

Feel the intensity of close-quarters zombie combat

Fast, responsive gunplay designed for immersion and comfort

This is not just shooting — it’s fighting for survival.

🧱 DEFEND THE LAST FORTRESS

The environment is a post-apocalyptic stronghold, built as humanity’s final defense.
Hold chokepoints, control lanes, and adapt your tactics as the undead overwhelm your position.

If the fortress falls, humanity falls with it.

⚡ FEATURES

Immersive VR zombie shooter gameplay

Endless wave survival mode

Increasing difficulty and enemy variety

Post-apocalyptic fortress setting

Designed for intense, replayable sessions

Optimized for smooth VR performance

☠️ HOW LONG CAN YOU LAST?

There is no victory screen.
